formattedAddress: 112, Taiwan, Taipei City, Beitou District, Lane 333, Mingde Rd, 35號1樓

text.text:
Located in Lane 331, Mingde Road, this family-run restaurant offers a comfortable and clean dining environment. The menu mainly features elaborate dishes, with set meals and individual items available, priced according to the specific dish. We ordered seafood fried noodles (NT$220), handmade chive dumplings (13 dumplings/NT$130), and pickled cabbage and oyster soup (NT$100).

Seafood Fried Noodles: Includes shredded pork, 2 white shrimp, fresh oysters, clams, etc.; the noodles are yellow noodles (ramen). The flavor is not greasy or overly salty, and the ingredients are quite fresh.

Handmade Dumplings: The dumplings are perfectly fried, arranged bottom-up like flowers, which is very pretty. The restaurant provides a special sauce, and the outer skin is crispy and delicious, with each dumpling being a satisfying snack.

Although located in an alley, the food preparation is not haphazard; they also offer free Wi-Fi and sweet soup (handmade grass jelly and mung bean soup) for customers, showing their attention to detail (80).

originalText.text:
位於明德路331巷內、家庭式的餐館，店內用餐環境還算是舒適整潔；菜單多屬功夫菜、也有套餐與單品可選擇，價位上依餐點與菜色的不同而有異。我們點海鮮炒麵（220元）/手工韭菜煎餃（13顆/130元）/酸菜鮮蚵湯（100元）。

海鮮炒麵：包括豬肉絲、白蝦*2、鮮蚵、蛤蠣等；麵條使用的是黃麵（拉麵）。口味上不油膩不死鹹，用料算是新鮮。
手工煎餃：水餃煎到洽洽、底部朝上擺狀類似朵花很漂亮；店家提供特製醬料、外皮口感酥脆且一顆一顆接著吃都不膩。

該店雖開在巷內、餐點製作卻不會隨便；還提供免費wi-if以及甜湯（手工仙草綠豆湯）給顧客享用，用心度可以看得到（80）。

text.text: The tender chicken rice is a must-order! It's topped with a soft-boiled egg 😋 They also offer complimentary sweet soup.

text.text:
December 2025 Second Visit
This time, I ordered a few dishes:

1. Tender Chicken Rice ($110): Very delicious. The chicken had a smoky flavor and came with two kinds of green vegetables and a poached egg.

2. Pineapple Bitter Melon Chicken Soup ($80): One chicken wing, a bit too much. The chicken soup was noticeably sweet, which didn't suit my taste.

3. Stir-fried Vegetables ($100): The stir-fried red amaranth was good, retaining its crispness.

4. Scallion Beef Set Meal ($250): Freshly stir-fried beef, a decent amount of meat and scallions, two side dishes, and a large bowl of rice. It would be filling for women, but a bit empty for men.

February 2025 First Visit:
Seafood Ramen ($210): Quite little in the bowl, left me feeling a bit empty. The oysters were fresh, and there was a sweet soup included. Seeing the high ratings, I'll come back another day to try other dishes.

originalText.text:
2025/12二訪
這次改成點
1. 鮮嫩雞肉飯$110:很好吃，雞肉有煙燻口感，搭配兩樣青菜和荷包蛋
2. 鳳梨苦瓜雞湯$80: 一塊雞翅，稍嫌空虛，雞湯是有明顯甜味，不符合個人口味
3. 炒時蔬$100: 紅鳳菜炒的不錯，清脆度仍有保留
4. 蔥爆牛肉套餐$250: 現炒的牛肉，肉和蔥還算多，有兩樣配菜，飯算大碗，女生吃會飽，男生吃會有點空虛

2025/2 初訪：
海鮮拉麵$210
料蠻少的，吃完覺得蠻空虛，蚵仔新鮮，內用有甜湯可以喝，看評價高分改天再來試試別的

text.text:
Every dish is cooked to order, especially the stir-fried vegetables, which are crispy, refreshing, and perfectly seasoned. Highly recommended!
For the main course, I ordered chicken rice with a poached egg, accompanied by simple side dishes and a bowl of soup. The portion was just right, and the flavors were homely and warm.
The complimentary mung bean soup was a real bonus, especially when dining in.
The overall environment is clean and bright, and the staff are friendly. It's a place you'll want to return for more.

originalText.text:
每道餐點都是現點現做，尤其是炒青菜，清脆爽口、調味剛剛好，非常推薦！
主餐點了雞肉飯＋荷包蛋，再配上簡單配菜和一碗湯，份量剛好、味道也很家常溫暖。
重點是內用還有免費的綠豆湯可以喝，冰冰涼涼超加分～
整體環境乾淨明亮，店員也很親切，是會讓人想再回訪

text.text: This was the first time I brought my 83-year-old mother-in-law to dine here. We ordered the scrambled eggs with beef set meal, Mapo tofu set meal, chicken rice, and pineapple and bitter melon chicken soup. My mother-in-law praised the tender scrambled eggs with beef. The pineapple and bitter melon chicken soup had a layered flavor, and the Mapo tofu had a spicy and numbing taste that went very well with rice. The only downside was that there weren't enough side dishes; it was almost all glass noodles. It would have been perfect if the side dishes were more evenly distributed.

originalText.text: 第一次帶83歲的婆婆來用餐，點了滑蛋牛肉套餐、麻婆豆腐套餐、雞肉飯、鳳梨苦瓜雞湯。滑蛋牛肉軟嫩婆婆讚不絕口，鳳梨苦瓜雞湯味道有層次，麻婆豆腐有椒麻味很下飯，唯一缺點是菜佩的有點少，幾乎都是冬粉，如果配菜可以平均一點就太好了。
